# MarkDown Stripper (https://markdown-stripper.site)

> Free, fast browser Markdown/document converter with local privacy-first processing.

## Overview
MarkDown Stripper converts GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM), CommonMark, LLM outputs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek), and technical documentation into clean, unformatted plain text or formatted Microsoft Word (.docx) files in real time.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Zero-Latency Real-Time Stripping**: Client-side parsing instantly strips headings, bold/italics, code fences, blockquotes, tables, and raw markup.
- **Privacy & Security**: Conversion, import, OCR, safety scanning, and semantic review run in the browser. Aggregate usage measurements contain no document content, filenames, session IDs, or device profiles.
- **Multi-Format Export**: One-click clipboard copy, plain text (`.txt`) download, and Microsoft Word (`.docx`) synthesis.
- **Deep Asset Extraction**: Automatically catalogues embedded hyperlinks, images (`![alt](url)`), and email addresses into an interactive panel.
- **Purpose-Aware Modes**: Plain, Readable, and AI-ready output from one fast local conversion pipeline.
- **Reference Resolution**: Resolves inline and reference-style links, reports broken definitions, and arranges sources at the bottom.
- **Safety & Privacy Scan**: Instantly flags exact secrets, personal data, invisible text, hidden comments, and possible prompt injection. An optional browser-only English PII model adds a deeper contextual scan without uploading the document.
- **Document Import**: Local Markdown, TXT, HTML, DOCX, PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, and GIF extraction with lazy-loaded parsers.
- **Private OCR**: Scanned PDF pages and images can be converted to selectable text locally with language suggestions, page progress, and confidence warnings.
- **Semantic Insights**: Optional local embeddings compare substantial paragraphs and surface likely repetition without rewriting text.
- **Drag & Drop**: Native file input and drag-and-drop support for Markdown, documents, and images.
- **URL Parameter Sharing**: Supports pre-filling text via URL query parameters (`?text=...` or `?sample=chatgpt`).

## WebMCP agent workflow
- The top-level page registers 14 imperative WebMCP tools when `document.modelContext` is available.
- The handoff remains review-first: a person must approve the exact reviewed version in Insights before agent copy/export tools can run.
- Read tools expose bounded document state, converted output, extracted assets, privacy findings, and a content-free handoff readiness checklist.
- Write tools can set content/options, prepare an AI-ready handoff, start local privacy scanning, redact reviewed findings, copy/download output, insert the sample, and clear the editor.
- Agents work with the same visible page state as the human. Content-bearing tool results are bounded and marked untrusted; conversion, OCR, scanning, and redaction remain local to the browser.
- Suggested prompt: “Prepare this document for an agent handoff, check readiness, and tell me what I should review. Do not share or export anything until I approve it.”

## Syntax Handled
- Headings: `# H1` through `###### H6` -> plain title text
- Emphasis: `**bold**`, `__bold__`, `*italic*`, `_italic_`, `~~strikethrough~~` -> plain text
- Links & Media: `[Anchor](https://...)` -> `Anchor` (URL extracted to Assets panel)
- Code blocks: Backtick fences and inline code -> clean text
- Blockquotes: `> quote` -> clean paragraph
- Lists: Ordered, unordered, and GitHub task checkboxes (`- [x]`) -> formatted lines
- HTML tags: Inline tags stripped cleanly
